sentences.text: Tehana and Colombia. Part one introduction. Carta Hana is a beautiful city in Colombia.
It is next to the Caribbean Sea. Carta Hana is very popular with tourists. It is famous for
its colorful houses, historic walls, and warm weather. The city is also known as Carta Hana de
India. Part two history. Carta Hana has a long history. It was founded by the Spanish in 1533.
In the past, the city was very important for trade. It was also a target for pirates. That is why
Carta Hana has big stone walls and forts. The most famous fort is Castillo San Felipe de Barajas.
It is one of the largest forts in South America. Today Carta Hana is a UNESCO World Heritage site.
Part three nature and beaches. Carta Hana has many beautiful beaches. The sea is blue and clear.
You can swim, relax, and enjoy the sun. Close to Carta Hana, there are the Rosario Islands.
These islands are famous for their white sand and coral reefs. Many people go there for boat trips.
Carta Hana is also close to mangrove forests. You can take a canoe and explore the quiet nature.
Part four food in Carta Hana. The food is delicious. People eat fresh seafood like fish, shrimp, and crab.
A popular dish is ceviche. It is made with raw fish, lemon juice, onion, and herbs. People also enjoy
arribas, a type of cornbread. Another popular snack is empanadas. Small fried pastries with meat or cheese.
Fresh fruit is everywhere. You can drink mango juice, coconut water, or passion fruit juice.
On the streets, women called palincadas were colorful dresses. They sell fruit like pineapple,
papaya, and watermelon. Part five culture. Carta Hana has a very rich culture. The city has music,
dance, and festivals. A famous dance is kumbia which comes from Colombia. You can hear lively
Caribbean music in the streets. People in Carta Hana love to dance and celebrate. Carta Hana is
also full of art. The streets have many colorful murals and paintings. There are also markets
where you can buy handmade crafts. Carta Hana is a mix of Spanish, African, and Caribbean traditions.
Part six festivals. Carta Hana is famous for its festivals. One of the biggest is the Independence
Day festival in November. There are parades, costumes, music, and street parties. Another festival is
the Hay Festival in January. Writers, artists, and musicians from all over the world come to Carta Hana.
They share books, ideas, and performances. Carta Hana also celebrates Holy Week in April.
There are beautiful processions and traditions in the old city. These festivals make Carta Hana
lively and full of energy. Part seven, daily life. In daily life, people in Carta Hana are
friendly and relaxed. They like to spend time outside. Many people meet in the plazas or squares
to talk and enjoy music. Children play in the streets and families go for walks in the evening.
Life is slower near the sea and people enjoy the warm nights.
Part eight, fun facts. Carta Hana is sometimes called the jewel of the Caribbean.
The old city is full of bright yellow, blue, and pink houses. Famous writer Gabriel Garcia Marquez
lived in Carta Hana. Many movies and TV shows were filmed in Carta Hana. The city has both
modern skyscrapers and old colonial streets. That is all for today.
Now you know many things about Carta Hana Columbia. It is a city with history, beaches,
something new today.
